body:
## Overview
Four calls between the three components: staff ask the booking service, which asks the store; the administration service changes the store.
## Flow
- FLOW-001 COMP-001 -> COMP-003: asks if a room is free. Derives from: IFC-001, COMP-001, COMP-003
- FLOW-002 COMP-003 -> COMP-001: answers free or taken. Derives from: IFC-001, COMP-001, COMP-003
- FLOW-003 COMP-002 -> COMP-003: changes the room list. Derives from: IFC-002, COMP-002, COMP-003
- FLOW-004 COMP-003 -> COMP-002: confirms the change. Derives from: IFC-002, COMP-002, COMP-003
## Coverage check
None.
## Open questions
None.
